_cost_sources.primary: ESMAP Mini Grids for Half a Billion People (2022), AMDA Benchmark Report 2023, IRENA Renewable Power Generation Costs 2023, AfDB Desert to Power data
_cost_sources.notes: SSA mini-grid installed costs are 2-4x higher than utility-scale due to logistics, small project scale, and distribution infrastructure. ESMAP 2022 reports median installed cost of $4,200/kW for solar-hybrid mini-grids in SSA. AMDA 2023 reports $3,800-5,500/kW for systems under 100kWp. Battery costs have declined ~15% since 2022 for LFP.

capex_unit_costs._pv_source: IRENA 2023: utility-scale SSA $400-600/kWp; mini-grid adder 20-40% for logistics, small-lot. ESMAP 2022 median PV module cost for SSA mini-grids: $550-650/kWp installed
capex_unit_costs._battery_source: BNEF 2024: LFP pack prices $130-145/kWh globally; SSA installed with EMS $250-350/kWh. AMDA 2023 benchmark: $280-380/kWh for <200kWh systems in East Africa
capex_unit_costs._inverter_source: ESMAP 2022: hybrid inverter + charge controller $350-500/kWac for mini-grid scale. SMA/Victron pricing for SSA distributors
capex_unit_costs._distribution_source: AMDA 2023: $300-800/connection for LV networks in SSA; ESMAP median $450/connection. Distribution costs are computed separately by the distribution engine
capex_unit_costs._civil_source: ESMAP 2022: civil works $12,000-25,000 fixed for <100kWp rural SSA sites

distribution._source: ESMAP 2022: distribution median $250/customer (p25=$163, p75=$331), 26-27% of total CAPEX. SSA planning range $300-500/customer. Service drop reflects standardized ready-board approach. Labour/soft costs calibrated so terrain is applied once (line length) not twice

opex._source: ESMAP 2022: total OPEX 3-6% of CAPEX for SSA mini-grids. AMDA 2023: generation O&M 2.5-4% of gen CAPEX, distribution O&M 1-2% of dist CAPEX. Security costs higher in remote Mozambique locations

replacement_cycles._source: ESMAP 2022: battery replacement at year 8-12 at 50-70% of original cost (declining costs offset by logistics). IRENA 2023: LFP cycle life supports 10-year replacement for mini-grid duty cycles

financing._source: ESMAP 2022: typical SSA mini-grid financing 30-50% grant, 25-40% debt, 15-30% equity. AfDB Desert to Power: concessional debt 4-6%. World Bank ROGEP: grant-heavy structures for first-access sites

connection_growth._source: AMDA 2023: year 1 connection rates 40-70% across SSA; growth 3-8%/year depending on tariff and service quality

tariff._source: ESMAP 2022: cost-reflective mini-grid tariffs in SSA range $0.40-0.80/kWh. AMDA 2023: median realized tariff $0.45/kWh in East Africa. Mozambique ARENE framework allows cost-reflective pricing under Decree 93/2021
